backups.heading: Backups & retention
backups.retentionHelp: Recorded here, enforced on the host. scripts/backup.sh runs as a cron job outside the application and reads KEEP_DAILY from .env; it cannot query this database at the time it prunes. Changing this value records the programme’s intent — ask IT to set KEEP_DAILY to match. Said plainly because this field previously implied it controlled the retention directly, and it never has.

status.heading: Backup & restore status
status.backupNotReported: not reported to the app — see last-backup.txt on the host
status.restoreNotReported: not reported to the app — see last_restore_drill.json on the host
status.sources: Sources: the latest backup.complete and restore.complete rows in audit_log, which scripts/backup.sh and scripts/restore.sh write after each successful run. Each also records its last run on the host, in /var/lib/gml/backups/last-backup.txt and workspace/last_restore_drill.json (the stamp deploy.sh’s restore-drill gate reads); look there when a time is not reported here.

transcodeJobs.title: Transcode jobs
transcodeJobs.intro: Inspect and operate the ffmpeg → HLS 480p pipeline. Failed rows are listed first; click Retry to re-enqueue a job onto the queue, or Drop to bury it without retry. Each attempt is its own row; only a video's latest attempt, while the video is failed, can be retried or dropped. Every action is logged to the audit trail.

errors.missing_job_id: That action arrived without a job id. Try again from the table.
errors.job_not_found: That job no longer exists — it may have been pruned.
errors.not_retriable_status: Only a failed job can be retried. This one has since changed state; reload to see its current status.
errors.not_droppable_status: Only a failed job can be dropped. Reload to see its current status.
errors.not_failed_attempt: Only a failed attempt can be retried or dropped. Reload to see its current status.
errors.not_latest_attempt: That was an older attempt of this video. Only its latest attempt can be retried or dropped.
errors.job_live: That video already has a transcode queued or running. Reload to see its current status.
errors.submission_not_failed: That video is no longer failed — it has been retried or has become ready since. Reload to see it.
errors.unknown: That action could not be completed.

transcodeJobs.dbDown: Live queue depth unavailable (the database is unreachable). The historical job table below is still accurate.

dead.label: dead jobs
dead.heading: Dead jobs, every queue ({count})
dead.intro: Jobs whose attempts are exhausted, with the error the queue recorded. To retry a dead transcode, use Retry on the video's latest failed attempt below. A dead retention sweep runs again the next day by itself.

transcodeJobs.empty: No transcode jobs match the current filter.
transcodeJobs.footer: Showing the most recent {limit} transcode jobs. Errors are truncated to 60 characters; hover to see the full text. For the full audit history (retries, drops, worker errors) see <link>/admin/audit</link>.

whatsappLog.title: WhatsApp ingest log
whatsappLog.intro: Every video sent to the GML WhatsApp number. A caption carrying OBS- / TB- / MM- and a code the sender may use links the upload to that observation cycle, teach-back, or mentor meeting; everything else is kept as a generic submission, visible to admins and the sender, with its caption and sender shown here. The app has no control yet for attaching a generic video to a cycle afterwards: ask the teacher to send it again with the cycle code as the caption.

errors.missing_submission_id: No submission was given. Use the button on the row.
errors.not_whatsapp_source: That submission did not arrive through WhatsApp.
errors.cannot_resend_finalised: That video has already been processed or reviewed, so it is not transcoded again.
errors.media_not_fetched: That video's media was never fetched from WhatsApp, so there is nothing to transcode. Use Retry fetch.
errors.no_media_id: That video arrived before the WhatsApp media id was recorded, so it cannot be fetched again. Ask the sender to send it again.
errors.already_fetched: That video's media is already stored. Use Resend transcode instead.
errors.cannot_refetch_status: That video is already being processed or has been, so its media is not fetched again.
errors.unknown: That action could not be completed.

config.off: WhatsApp ingest is off: WHATSAPP_APP_SECRET is not set, so the webhook refuses all traffic. Direct upload is unaffected.
config.partial: WhatsApp ingest is only partly configured.

missing.WHATSAPP_VERIFY_TOKEN: <mono>{name}</mono> is not set: Meta's webhook verification is refused.
missing.WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN: <mono>{name}</mono> is not set: videos are recorded but cannot be fetched from Meta.
missing.WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID: <mono>{name}</mono> is not set: senders get no reply.

whatsappLog.deadFetches: {count} WhatsApp video fetch(es) gave up in the last 24 hours; each row below shows why, with Retry fetch.
whatsappLog.empty: No WhatsApp ingest events match the current filter.
whatsappLog.footer: Showing the most recent {limit} WhatsApp submissions. For full WhatsApp audit-trail history (parse failures, signature rejections, media-fetch errors) see <link>/admin/audit</link>.
